description: Create a new skill in your own skills folder from a lesson that held in two contexts. Only when no skill you have covers it (otherwise use propose_skill_update); it must have every section filled (Job, When to use, Steps, Tools, Proof). Checked strictly; the user can review or delete it.

body.description: The SKILL.md body with the sections ## Job, ## When to use, ## Steps, ## Tools and ## Proof, each filled.

description.description: One line: when this skill applies (its cue).

lesson.description: Memory id of the lesson this skill distils (`lesson #<id>` in your memory); it must have held in two contexts.

name.description: 1-64 characters of a-z, 0-9 and single hyphens; must not be the name of a skill you already have.

title: propose_new_skill
